title: Sar Khule Kis Tarah Darbaar Me Jaaye Zainab
body:
Sar khule kis tarha darbar me jaye Zainab
Aa mere ghazi tujhe rokar bulaye Zainab
Haye darbar sajate hai sabhi ahle shar
Isliye rok-rakha hai hame kab se dar par
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaise iss karb se ab khud ko chipaye Zainab
Raat ki oss hai aur dhoop hai din ki bhayya
Be-rida hum hai yaha sar pa nahi hai saaya
Ab kahan aale mohammed ko chupaye Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Teen din hogaye sab ahle haram rote hai
Dekhne hum ko tamashai jama hote hai
Ho zameen shaq tho zameen me hi samaye Zainab
Gham shaheedo ka har ek gaam pa rulata raha
<<DIVIDER>>
Dard parde ka hamesha mujhe tadpata raha
Ek hi dil pe sitam kitne uthaye Zainab
Hum pe bazar me barsate the zalim pathar
Waar karte the dilon par hume baghi khekar
<<DIVIDER>>
Sabr karti thi faqat sar ko jhukaye Zainab
Hai sar-e-naiza jo sar pyase Ali Asghar ka
Halq pa uske bhi qanjar maine chalta dekha
Kistarha paani ko ab muh se lagaye Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Pusht-e-sajjad pe barsata hai zalim durre
Zulm beemar pe hota hai mai dekhu kaise
Mere Abbas kahin mar hi na jaye Zainab
Baap ke seene pa soti thi Sakina bhayya
<<DIVIDER>>
Har ghadi gham se tadapti haibyateema bhayya
Qakh pa kaise bhala usko sulaye Zainab
Mout ke hath se majboor hoon aye shehzadi
Neher pe tadpi bahut ye khekar ye lash-e-ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
Bar-sare dosh-e-hawa sunke sadaye Zainab
Sar-e-darbar tha ek karb ka manzar javed
Khoon rota raha ghazi ka kata sar javed
Siskiya leke usse jab bhi bulaye Zainab
